# Sandeep Kumar Portfolio - Project Instructions

This is a React 18 portfolio website built with Vite and Tailwind CSS.

## Project Overview
- Built with React 18 and Vite for optimal performance
- Styled with Tailwind CSS for responsive design
- Showcases Sandeep Kumar's professional experience as a ServiceNow Developer

## Setup Instructions
1. Install dependencies: `npm install`
2. Start development server: `npm run dev`
3. Build for production: `npm run build`

## Project Structure
```
src/
├── components/        # Reusable React components
├── pages/            # Page components
├── data/             # Portfolio data
├── App.jsx           # Main App component
└── App.css           # Global styles
```
